analyst_view.overall: Dinamo Zagreb (9th, 7 points) host Bayer Leverkusen (7th, 9 points) at the Maksimir, both chasing the top-eight places. Dinamo have a new coach, Jerko Leko, who has won all three games in charge: 2-0 at Sunderland in this competition, 3-1 at Varazdin and 3-2 against Istra on Sunday. Captain Scott McKenna has been out since a training injury in late October and Robert Mudrazija is also injured; both are in the numbers' missing list and their absence already shows in Dinamo's recent results. Leverkusen won 4-0 against Paderborn and get Maza, Diaby, Tella and Kofane back, while Martin Terrier and Kennet Eichhorn remain out and Guela Doue is doubtful (all three in the missing list). No referee is named yet; with the absences already in the numbers, I now stay with the numbers on every stat (previously a small lean higher on goals).

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, 2.1 of them for Leverkusen. I had leaned slightly higher for McKenna's absence, but he is now in the numbers' missing list and has been out for about a month, during which Dinamo conceded fewer than expected; Leverkusen's returning forwards (Kofane, Diaby) only bring them back to full strength. I stay at about 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, 6.3 for Leverkusen, who have won a lot of corners lately (already counted, +1.6%). Leverkusen should have most of the ball as usual, and the coaching change at Dinamo has not changed how they play at home in a way the numbers miss, so I stay at about 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, fairly even between the sides, and already nudge both up slightly for recent bookings. No referee is named yet; the Maksimir crowd can raise the temperature, but that is part of Dinamo's home record, so I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.8 shots and already lift Leverkusen for heavy recent shooting (+6.4%). Kofane and Diaby returning adds options while Terrier is still out, and Dinamo under Leko have been on the front foot, but nothing clearly moves the total, so I stay at about 27.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 on target and already lift Leverkusen (+6.8%) after 45 on target in their last six. With the absences on both sides already in the missing list, I stay at about 9.9.
